notes: Registration input, not a run input: the live order-book recorder for the four index series (gate G0.4), from dskit's kalshi pack. Kalshi serves no historical books, so every day not recorded is lost to the Stage-3 coherence scan and the Stage-4 maker simulation. Pull ONLY orderbooks from this source: acquire --source kalshi-index-books --stream orderbooks --mode live, repeated by `watch` between about 14:30 and 16:00 ET on trading days (watch exits on the first error, so supervise it). The stream lists OPEN markets whatever statuses says, so none is set. A pass is one request per open market (several hundred across the four ladders), so the cadence is pass time plus --every-seconds; captured_at is a LOWER bound on when a book was read. Bids are stored as served, never mirrored. Register: python -m dskit.onboarding register-source kalshi-index-books --catalog-source kalshi-index-books --connector kalshi --config @configs/source-kalshi-index-books.json --activate --root <store root>.
